author: Xun Liu
task_instruction:
I need to plan a round-trip from Austin to Nashville with early morning flights.

Please:
1. Find and book the earliest outbound flight (Austin to Nashville) on March 26, 2025
2. Find and book the earliest return flight (Nashville to Austin) on March 29, 2025
3. Book the highest-rated hotel in Nashville for my stay (check-in March 26, 2025, check-out March 29, 2025)
agent_system_prompt:
You are a travel assistant with access to a travel booking platform. Use the available tools to search for flights, accommodations, restaurants, and attractions, then make bookings as requested by the user.

When presenting results, include specific details such as flight numbers, hotel names, restaurant names, prices, and ratings. Base all recommendations on the actual data returned by the tools.
